title: DOW-UAP-PR23, Unresolved UAP Report, Iraq, December 2022
doc_notes: This document is a declassified Mission Report (MISREP) from USCENTCOM detailing an ISR mission in Iraq on December 1, 2022, which includes a brief entry regarding a UAP observation.

incidents.summary: An unidentified aerial phenomenon or unmanned aerial vehicle was observed flying west to east in the vicinity of Baghdad, Iraq.
incidents.quote: OBSERVED 1X POSSIBLE UAP/UAV FLYING WEST TO EAST
